description: Prices for one event found with search_ticket_prices: its current "from" price, the cheapest price in each seating section, the daily lowest price over the last 30 days, whether it is rising or falling against a week ago, how many listings there are, and the link for a free price-drop alert. Pass the eventId from a search_ticket_prices result. Use it for questions like "which section is cheapest?", "has the price gone up?" or "is now a good time to buy?". Prices are per ticket before the seller's fees, from StubHub listings checked by NeedATicket.

event_id.description: The eventId of a search_ticket_prices result.

name: get_event_prices
title: Get one event's prices by section and over time
